# Lakeland Surveying
Licensed New Jersey professional land surveyors. Shore office in Lavallette, Ocean County. Firm established 1972.

Address: 1501 Grand Central Avenue, Lavallette, NJ 08735
Phone: 917-463-6042
Primary shore site: https://landsurveyingoceancountynj.com/
Also: https://lakelandsurveying.com/

This site has dedicated pages for 9 South Jersey counties. Crews are available statewide on request.
Services: FEMA elevation certificates, boundary surveys, property-line disputes, topographic surveys, title and ALTA/NSPS surveys, construction stakeout, condominium surveys.

A straightforward residential boundary survey in Ocean County commonly runs about $800 to $3,500. Barrier-island and waterfront work often costs more. Fees are confirmed from the address.

- https://landsurveyingoceancountynj.com/services/boundary-surveys.html

- https://landsurveyingoceancountynj.com/areas/ocean-county.html
